title: Michigan State University International Merit Scholarships
program_type: Undergraduate admissions merit scholarships for non-resident international first-year students
duration: Renewable for up to eight consecutive fall and spring semesters as an undergraduate
description: Michigan State University awards a set of scholarships to incoming first-year students with non-U.S. residency status, with no separate application beyond the admission application. The main award is the MSU Non-resident Scholarship, granted at six levels from $3,000 to $18,000 per year on academic performance, with decisions released by mid-February. title: University of Oregon International Cultural Service Program
program_type: Cultural service work-learning tuition waiver for international students
duration: Renewable annually until completion of a UO degree, provided ICSP programme requirements are met
description: As cross-cultural ambassadors in the Eugene-Springfield area, ICSP recipients receive a scholarship covering approximately half their tuition and, in exchange, lead presentations about their home culture in local schools and community organizations.

title: Clarendon Fund Scholarships
program_type: Doctoral and taught postgraduate scholarship scheme based on academic merit
duration: Normally the scholar's period of fee liability; at the discretion of the academic divisions some awards extend beyond it with only the living grant paid in the extra period
description: The Clarendon Fund offers over 200 new fully-funded scholarships each year to outstanding graduate scholars at the University of Oxford, covering course fees in full and paying a grant for living expenses. There is no separate scholarship application: candidates are considered automatically if they apply for a new full-time or part-time Master's or DPhil by the December or January admissions deadline for their course, and departments nominate to their division for divisional ranking. title: Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme
program_type: Fully-funded graduate scholarship with a leadership development programme
duration: The full duration of the fee liability for the agreed course
description: The Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme provides fully-funded graduate scholarships at the University of Oxford together with a year-long programme of leadership development, long-term mentoring and networking. The scholarship covers 100% of course fees and a living-costs grant of at least GBP 21,805 for the full fee liability of the agreed course. Applicants must be ordinarily resident in one of a long list of eligible countries, apply to an eligible course by that course's December or January deadline, and upload the Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships Statement.

title: Reach Oxford Scholarship
program_type: Undergraduate bursary for candidates from low-income countries who cannot study for a degree in their own country
duration: 3 or 4 years depending on course length
description: Reach Oxford scholarships (formerly Oxford Student Scholarships) are offered to students from low-income countries who, for political or financial reasons, or because suitable educational facilities do not exist, cannot study for a degree in their own countries. The University states the scheme is only suitable for candidates who have received an offer and who are of the highest academic ability.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
official_source: Gates Cambridge Trust, with the University of Cambridge
program_type: Full-cost postgraduate scholarship at the University of Cambridge
duration: Up to four years for PhD scholars; the maintenance allowance is paid for 12 months and pro rata for shorter courses
description: A fully funded graduate education for future leaders committed to improving the lives of others.

title: Cambridge Trust International Scholarship
official_source: The Cambridge Trust (Cambridge Commonwealth, European & International Trust)
program_type: Full-cost postgraduate scholarship at the University of Cambridge awarded on academic merit
duration: For the duration of the funded course; the Trust does not publish a fixed term because it follows the course
description: The Cambridge Trust provides scholarships and grants for study and research at the University of Cambridge.
